lines.text: Okay. Okay. My fault. Long night.
Forget it, pal. I'm out of line.
Hold it, hold it. I'm done. We're done.
Fine. My mistake. Rule six: know when to walk.
Alright. I'm sorry. Don't make it a speech.
Enough. I'm not doing this on Eighth Avenue. Sorry.
I apologise. Sincerely. I am a gentleman, mostly.
Forgive me. It's the heat. And the bank.
Stop! Stop. I'm sorry. My heart. My suit. I'm sorry.
